AAAI2024.paper: Budd, Lacerda, Hawes, Stop! Planner Time
AAAI2024.method: DQN over contextual abstract metalevel MDP; performance profiles implicit in learned value, not a fitted curve with a simple threshold

training_pool_check.rule: Any new baseline fit/normalization/validation must exclude all seven evaluation date families, including their variants.

implementation_requirements: Freeze mapping of quality/time/context/action to grid task before fitting.
Retain original DQN replay/target/update algorithm or record every change.
Do not label a hand-designed stop threshold as the published DQN method.
If tuning action disabled, name stopping-only adaptation; do not claim full method.
Do not sum grid cost and seconds without an explicit source-consistent normalization.
Record training and calibration costs separately from online full controller time.
Evaluate same controller/order/cache/actions/feedback and all fixed seeds.
If complete return/counterfactuals needed, count actual generation cost; one-step FULL logs do not supply long-term counterfactual values.
